target.title: fix(text): harden string helpers against small/degenerate inputs
target.body:
## Summary

Four internal string helpers violate their invariants on inputs **outside their current call sites**. Every present caller passes safe values (verified below), so these are **latent** hardening fixes — not live bugs. Surfaced by property-testing with einsiedlerkrebs.

## What to review

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/clawsweeper-text.ts` | `trimMiddle`: fall back to a head truncation when `maxLength < 120` |
| `src/repair/text-utils.ts` | `compactText`: drop the ellipsis when it doesn't fit; `slug`: re-trim a trailing dash after the length slice |
| `src/repair/comment-router-utils.ts` | `normalizeGitHubActor`: strip **all** trailing `[bot]` |
| `test/clawsweeper-text.test.ts`, `test/repair/text-utils.test.ts`, `test/repair/comment-router-utils.test.ts` | 5 regression + unregression tests |

## The bugs (all latent — no current call site triggers them)

- **`trimMiddle`**: `edge = floor((maxLength-120)/2)` goes negative for `maxLength < 120` — slices read the wrong ends (`slice(-0)` returns the whole string) and the "truncated N" count exceeds the input length. Now falls back to `truncateText`. *(callers pass 1000–4000.)*
- **`compactText`**: `maxLength <= 2` returned the bare `"..."` (length 3), overflowing the cap. Now drops the ellipsis when there is no room. *(callers pass 100–1600.)*
- **`slug`**: the length slice ran **after** the trailing-dash trim, so slicing on a `-` boundary re-introduced a trailing dash — not idempotent. Now re-trims post-slice. *(callers use the default 120 on short IDs.)*
- **`normalizeGitHubActor`**: stripped only one trailing `[bot]`, leaving a residual on a doubled suffix — not idempotent. Now strips all. *(real logins are never doubled.)*

## Real-behavior proof (before/after)

`origin/main` vs this branch, identical inputs:

```
                                 BEFORE (origin/main)      AFTER (this branch)
compactText("hello world", 2)    "..."   (len 3 > cap 2)   "he"  (len 2)
slug("a a", …, 2)                "a-"    (idempotent=no)   "a"   (idempotent=yes)
normalizeGitHubActor("x[bot][bot]")  "x[bot]" (idem=no)    "x"   (idem=yes)
trimMiddle(25-char text, 20)     len 31, nonsense count    sane head truncation
```

Manual mutation kill-proof: reverting each fix to the buggy `origin/main` version makes its regression test fail — all 4 killed.

## Validation

- `pnpm run check` passes for the diff (build, lint, coverage:changed, format, + 5 new tests). The sole `pnpm check` failure is a **pre-existing** `test/dashboard-worker.test.ts:898` on `main` (deterministic under its mocked clock), unrelated to this diff.
- Runtime: kanarienkrebs strict layer over the diff-scoped tests — PASS.
- Mutation: manual revert-to-bug kill-proof (stryker instrumented 29 mutants but its dry-run can't run `pnpm build:all` in its sandbox).

## Scope

Latent hardening only — no behavior change on the safe inputs every current caller passes. Closes #571, #572, #573, #574.

## Review history

Review history: https://gist.github.com/6e9f050a900af5efba146a67fc6d98c1
